title: dorycnium strictum
intro: Dorycnium strictum, commonly known as Spurred Vetch or Bitter Vetch, is a perennial legume plant native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dorycnium strictum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. These compounds are believed to possess antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, making the plant a potential source of natural remedies.
